title: Phone verification PIN on the profile
summary: Account holders can now set a phone verification PIN on their profile, so APES staff can check who is calling. The PIN is never stored or shown in full.
changes: Add a Phone verification PIN section to the profile, where people set or change a 4 to 8 digit PIN.
Setting or changing the PIN asks people to confirm their password first.
The PIN is stored only in a protected form that lets staff check two digits later; it never appears on screen or in logs.
Record PIN changes in the audit log without the PIN.
version_rationale: Minor: starts the v0.49 phone verification epic with a new account feature and a new table.
validation: New feature test for setting and changing a PIN, re-authentication, storage, display, logs and invalid input.
Full PHPUnit suite and the MySQL contract job in CI.
known_limitations: Staff checking the PIN on calls arrives in the next release. Staff and volunteer accounts do not set a PIN.
rollback: Redeploy the previous release package. The new table can stay; earlier releases ignore it.
provenance: Milestone v0.49.3 Beta, issue #476 under epic #475, pull request #602.
